name: Coatbridge Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Coatbridge Community Centre. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Coatbridge Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Drumpellier Country Park. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Native Scottish varieties grown.
